subject: Acceptance fallback & bridge plan for Marketplace private offer
messages:
From: Theo Martin <theo.martin@novushealth.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & PO timing — private offer questions

Hi Irene,

We reviewed the private offer and want to move forward, but procurement needs clarity on two items before we sign: 1) acceptance evidence required to satisfy our finance team for invoice release, and 2) whether we can stagger the first invoice into two tranches (FY quarter constraints). Also curious if there is any temporary capacity (burst) available during the handoff window — we expect a small surge in April.

Attached is our provisional PO for your intake (PO_Novus_Prov.pdf). Can someone from your team outline the acceptance checklist and a fallback plan if marketplace acceptance slips?

Thanks,
Theo
Senior Procurement Manager
Novus Health

Attachments: PO_Novus_Prov.pdf (application/pdf)
From: irene_choi@redwood.com

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & PO timing — private offer questions

Hi Theo — thanks for the note and the provisional PO. Short answer up front: yes, we can support a staggered first invoice and a temporary burst/fallback capacity during acceptance, but we need to lock a few artifacts and dates. Outline below.

Acceptance & invoices
- Evidence: signed DocuSign of the private offer, acceptance-evidence-checklist completed (see template we’ll send), and a QA signoff from your SRE/engineering on the test tokens we’ll share.
- Billing: we can tranche the initial invoice into two: 60% at DocuSign execution, 40% on completion of the acceptance window (successful smoke tests).

Fallback/bridge capacity
- We can provision a 2-week burst pool (up to 30% above committed capacity) routed to your account regionally while the marketplace acceptance completes. This will be billed as on-demand at the committed rate until acceptance settles.

Next steps (proposed)
1) We’ll upload the acceptance checklist and the private-offer PDF into DocuSign by Thu 15 Mar.
2) Kimberly to confirm tax treatment for the tranche split and provide invoice routing.
3) Marissa to schedule the DocuSign window and share the HubSpot deal.
4) Theo/Priya to confirm PO final numbers and desired start date.

I’ll follow up with the checklist and the link.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Theo/Priya — summary and owners below so we can close the window this week. Please reply with a single-line confirm when you’re good and we’ll mark the HubSpot deal as ready-for-docsign.

Action items and deadlines:
- DocuSign execution window: Mar 20–23 (Marissa) — envelope live, link shared above.
- Final PO attached to envelope: Novus to upload (Theo) — due EOD Mar 20.
- Acceptance evidence: fill acceptance-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Novus) and complete smoke tests with our token set by Mar 22 (Novus SRE).
- Burst pool provisioning: Ben to allocate 2-week bridge (up to +30% committed) immediately upon execution; runbook posted to HubSpot (Ben) — done within 2 hrs of signature.

- SLA for burst: Redwood will provide a one-page SLA addendum for the temporary burst (latency targets and 24/7 escalation contacts) and attach to the DocuSign envelope (Irene) — delivered by Mar 21.
